Hi there 👋 Welcome to my homepage!

I'm an undergraduate student majoring in Communication Engineering at Tongji University, expecting to graduate in June 2027.

I explore simple, efficient ways to make AI more capable, from learning algorithms to the systems that train and deploy models. My interests span multimodal foundation models, image/video generation, AI infrastructure, and reinforcement learning for embodied agents.

I'm always open to exchanging ideas and exploring collaborations. Feel free to email me at chenceason10@gmail.com.

Publications

7 papers

* Equal contribution · † Corresponding author · ‡ Project lead

If You Hear It, Help Find It: Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization

Cheng Chen*, Yi Xu*‡, Wenzhuo Lei†

We study open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization when visual and audio teachers differ in reliability. OV-OrthKD places their supervision in separate orthogonal feature paths and uses text prototypes for open-vocabulary transfer.

ACM MM 2026

[PDF] [Project]

OrthKD: Extracting Generalized Clinical Knowledge from Heterogeneous Teachers for Lightweight Deployment

Yi Xu*†, Cheng Chen*‡, Mufan Cao

We study multi-teacher distillation for diabetic retinopathy screening. OrthKD transfers complementary feature-level knowledge from heterogeneous teachers to a 5.4M-parameter MobileNetV3 student.

IJCAI 2026

[PDF] [Code]

Enabling Visual Reasoning in Text-Only LLMs via Symbolic Scene Descriptions

Wenzhuo Lei, Mufan Cao, Chaorong Ye, Yi Xu, Cheng Chen†‡

We convert images into grammar-constrained scene descriptions for text-only LLMs. On a stratified 5,000-image VQAv2 subset, DeepYOLO reaches 42.3% accuracy using 1/2.5 as many prompt tokens as the scene-graph baseline.

IJCNN 2026

[PDF]

From Scores to Checks: A Human-Annotated Rubric Benchmark for AI-Generated Image Faithfulness

Cheng Chen and collaborators

Research on assessing whether generated images satisfy textual instructions, with a focus on reliable evaluation.
